phrase.zh: 微小粒子，也会留下波的图案。
phrase.en: Tiny particles can leave wave patterns.

visual.zh: 一束束光线穿过狭缝后形成明暗交错的弧线，以舞台般的空间表现干涉。图案不是实验屏幕的真实计数分布。
visual.en: Beams pass a slit-like opening into alternating arcs, staging interference in space. The pattern is not a measured count distribution on an experiment screen.

background.zh: 电子在晶体上的衍射实验说明，电子也具有波动行为；戴维森和 G. P. 汤姆森因此获得 1937 年物理学诺贝尔奖。量子“波”描述的是可检验的概率规律，不能把画中的光带当作电子的肉眼轨迹。
background.en: Electron diffraction from crystals demonstrated wave behavior in electrons; Davisson and G. P. Thomson received the 1937 Physics Nobel Prize for the experimental discovery. Quantum waves describe testable probability patterns, not naked-eye tracks like the painted bands.
